name: python/astral/lib
description: Python library on the Astral toolchain (uv, ruff, ty)

setup.description: Create the venv and install dependencies including dev extras

lint.description: Check formatting and lint without modifying files
steps: uv run ruff format --check --diff --config '{{.config_path}}' src tests
uv run ruff check --config '{{.config_path}}' src tests --no-fix

format.description: Apply ruff formatting and safe lint fixes in place
steps: uv run ruff format --config '{{.config_path}}' src tests
uv run ruff check --config '{{.config_path}}' src tests --fix

test.description: Run pytest with doctests, coverage, and junit output

build.description: Build source and wheel distributions with uv build

clean.description: Remove build artifacts and the virtualenv

show.description: Print the configured ruff/pytest config path
